title: 第13章 可能适合苏婉卿的功法第14章 自尽证明清白那你自尽吧
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第13章可能适合苏婉卿的功法？洞府之内，阳光透过窗子落下，到了楚宁的脸上。
刺眼的光芒很快是让楚宁有了反应，缓缓醒来。
脑壳隐隐作痛，显然消耗太多留下的后遗症，但问题不大，他醒来片刻之后就发现自己体内灵力充盈，神魂强横。
转头看去，地面有张草席和枕头。
看来师尊昨晚睡在了那里？
楚宁无奈苦笑。
本来是打算不继续睡在这里的，感觉不太合适，怎么都睡这里第二次了？
关键昨晚的场面，实在太过香艳了。
他必须得全神贯注才行，没想到一不小心就把自己榨干了。
一点都不剩的那种！
回想昨晚，小楚宁忍不住抬头。
楚宁肯定有道德，但某些东西肯定是没有。
它可不顾及什么师傅身份养育之恩，也不顾及别的。
只要有精力，就得看上两眼！
唉！
楚宁倒也没对昨天的事情忏悔什么，毕竟他也没做错，师尊也心甘情愿。
如今，师尊恢复修为是一件事情。
而他，提升修为也是一件事情。
在师尊修为恢复之前，楚宁是必须要护在苏婉卿身前的。
一如苏婉卿当年护着他！

楚宁
资质：中品灵根
修为：二境入微（进度：67%）！
功法：长春不灭决（第三层）
吞天魔功
飘渺剑诀（未入门）
略微思索，楚宁神识扩散出去，发现苏婉卿是在做饭。
而此刻，洞府之内，灵气远比楚宁洞府要充盈。
不如在此地，直接把修为拉满再说！
立刻取出灵石，施展吞天魔功！
魔气环绕，不只是周身灵气，还有灵气所带来的强悍灵气，此刻，吞天魔功所转化灵气而来的修为，近乎是将楚宁五脏六腑都要撕碎了！
可没关系，长春不灭！
这两种功法，简直相辅相成！
修为：二境入微（进度：100%圆满）！
不到一刻钟，不光是修为拉满，更是以长春不灭修复体内带来的伤势！
突破三境，那就在今日了。
content_en:
Chapter 13: A technique that might be suitable for Su Wanqing? Inside the cave, the sunlight fell through the window and hit Chu Ning's face.
The dazzling light quickly made Chu Ning react and slowly woke up.
There was a dull pain in his head, obviously the sequelae of too much consumption, but it was not a big problem. A moment after he woke up, he found that his body was full of spiritual power and his soul was powerful.
Turning around, he saw a straw mat and pillow on the ground.
It seems that Master slept there last night?
Chu Ning smiled helplessly.
I originally planned not to sleep here anymore, but it felt inappropriate. Why did I sleep here for the second time?
The key point is that the scene last night was too sexy.
He had to concentrate on it, but he accidentally squeezed himself dry.
The kind that doesn’t have any left!
Thinking back to last night, little Chu Ning couldn't help but look up.
Chu Ning definitely has morals, but there are definitely some things he doesn't have.
It doesn't care about the master's status and upbringing, nor does it care about anything else.
As long as you have the energy, you should take a look!
well!
Chu Ning didn't regret anything about what happened yesterday. After all, he didn't do anything wrong, and the master was willing.
Nowadays, Master’s restoration of cultivation is a matter of course.
And for him, improving his cultivation is also a matter of course.
Before the master recovers, Chu Ning must protect Su Wanqing.
Just like Su Wanqing protected him back then!
Chu Ning
Qualification: Middle-grade spiritual root
Cultivation level: Second level into micro level (progress: 67%)!
Kung Fu: Changchun Immortality Jue (Third Level)
Devouring Heaven Demonic Skill
Piaomiao Sword Technique (not yet started)
After thinking for a moment, Chu Ning's consciousness spread out and found that Su Wanqing was cooking.
At this moment, the spiritual energy in the cave was far richer than that in Chu Ning's cave.
It's better to go straight to maxing out your cultivation here!
Immediately take out the spirit stone and use the Heaven Swallowing Demon Technique!
The demonic energy surrounds him, not only the aura around his body, but also the powerful aura brought by the aura. At this moment, the cultivation level derived from the aura transformed by the Devouring Heaven Demon Technique is almost tearing Chu Ning's internal organs to pieces!
It doesn’t matter, Changchun will never die!
These two techniques simply complement each other!
Cultivation: Second level into micro level (Progress: 100% perfect)!
In less than a quarter of an hour, not only was the cultivation level reached full, but also the injuries caused in the body were repaired with Changchun Immortality!
Breaking through the three realms is today.
